scope: First frozen-backbone, native16 instance-memory pilot; not a leaderboard submission
split: 24 previously uninspected collection logs from official training pool: 16 train, 4 development, 4 project holdout. All official validation logs have prior inspection and are excluded.
backbones: Frozen B0 PTv3 and existing YOLO11n-seg/BoT-SORT; same forwards and exact shared observations across arms
inputs: Current PTv3 pooled decoder features, same-forward YOLO encoder features, raw probabilities, geometry, timestamp, raw visual class scores; causal history only
supervision: Official lidarseg and Panoptic nuScenes labels; instance labels available only for training losses and evaluation, never runtime association

training.identity: Train descriptor on training-instance point GT, then freeze encoder and descriptor, shared across all arms; predicted identities during semantic training
training.selection: minimum development point CE on observed instance points; epoch zero eligible; same initialization, capacity, data and steps for current-only and temporal arms

primary: point identity F1 from official panoptic GT
point association quality including unmatched GT

advancement.runtime: No end-to-end real-time claim from cached timings; require actual populated-instance ROS delivery, report cold start, p95 and backlog

reporting: Pilot failure remains failure; no architecture changes or tuning on project holdout. Preserve label map, source hashes, paired observations, failures and current-only control. 2Hz annotation gaps are not proof of physical occlusion.
